new: Open three pages you haven't visited yet that show a first-visit tip: Openings, a venture page, your CV, your score or the Privacy centre. Read the tip that appears.

old: You skipped the tour earlier. Find a way to watch it again. Then hide the getting-started checklist and try to get it back.
new: You skipped the tour earlier. Find a way to watch it again. Then hide your getting-started progress for today and find where it went.

old: The tour is replaying, and you know where the checklist went.
new: The tour is replaying, and you know where your progress went.
why: Matches the new task.

old: Hide checklist; it also hides when all items are done
At least 5 posts of different types at the tester's university
new: At least 5 posts of different types at the tester's university. Include posts older than 2 hours (the feed's seed stage), or the tester sees almost none; the pilot seed ages them.

old: Any signed-in tester
new: Any signed-in tester. Include posts older than 2 hours (the feed's seed stage), or the tester sees almost none; the pilot seed ages them.
why: New posts stay in the seed stage for 2 hours.

old: Answer a post's question, then change your answer. Come back after 15 minutes and try to change it again.
new: Answer a post's question, then change your answer. Come back after 10 minutes and try to change it again.
why: Answers lock after 10 minutes.

old: One post isn't for you and one person posts too often: see less of each. Then report the post titled '[UX test] report me'.
new: One post isn't for you and one person posts too often: see less of each. Report the post titled '[UX test] report me' first, then mute its author.
why: Mute target and report target are the same helper in practice.

old: Switch your phone between light and dark mode, then set your phone's text size to the largest. Browse Home, a venture page and your CV in each.
new: Switch your phone between light and dark mode, then set your browser's font size to the largest (Chrome: Settings > Accessibility > Text scaling), then your phone's text size. Browse Home, a venture page and your CV in each.
why: Browser font size and Android font scale behave differently.

old: Share something useful with students at your university: a short post with one photo. Make sure only your university sees it. Try a very large photo first.
new: Share something useful with students at your university: a short post with one photo. Make sure only your university sees it. Try a very large photo first. Once you've seen what happens with it, remove the big photo so the post has one photo.
why: Otherwise the post ends with two photos.

old: Helper comments on the tester's post
new: Helper comments on the tester's post. At least 3 helpers open the post in the app and answer its question positively (questions are assigned on view; the free public line needs 3+ positive answers).
why: Questions are assigned when a post is viewed.

old: Helper shares one normal post and one post the tester can't see (another university's university-only post)
new: Helper shares two posts in chat: one normal, and one university-only post at the tester's university that its author then deletes (to show the unavailable card).
why: A helper can't share a post the tester can't see.

old: Try to message someone who isn't your friend (find them in Explore). Then report a message from the helper marked '[UX test]'.
new: Try to message someone who isn't your friend: find Danish Helper in Explore. Then report a message from the helper marked '[UX test]'.
why: Explore filters alone return nobody until a name is typed (R53).

new: Check which devices are signed into your account and sign out of all devices. Then sign in again and sign out here, with Skilient open in two tabs.
